text:
maria: We should add a 'who touched policy' trace playback to the console. Not just a diff export — I want a scrubber so you can see routing decisions over time and the telemetry pings that caused fallbacks. @aj @kevin any API shapes in mind?
aj: Love the idea. Minimum export shape: actor, action_ts, policy_id, route_before, route_after, justification_id (optional), and request_id for cross-linking. Keep it line-delimited (NDJSON).
kevin: +1 on NDJSON but watch size. High-volume tenants could generate huge files. We should do change-only records and store compact deltas, not full snapshots per event. :thinking:
nora: For telemetry, do we include the raw decision metrics (latency, model_variant, quant_profile) or just an opaque bucket? Full metrics might be PII-ish?
aj: I think metrics should be bounded: include variant, seq_len_bucket, latency_ms_bucket, and a metrics_hash for deep-dive. Full raw token counts can stay out of exports unless requested.
tim: UI note — timeline scrubber should let you "jump to request" which opens a mini-playback showing console logs + routing table at that exact ts. Example API link: /api/v1/audit/playback?tenant=foo&req=REQ12345
kevin: Also need sampling strategy for telemetry rows. Full change stream for enterprise-only; sampled for self-serve. Sampling config should be tenant-configurable with default aggressiveness.
maria: Retention question: how long do we keep the playback data vs export blobs? We need legal/compliance defaults.
sre-bot: Reminder: default retention policy is 365 days for audit events. Exports stored in S3 follow bucket lifecycle; maintainers need to request extension for >1yr.
aj: For export generation we should gate with quotas: one background job per tenant, rate-limit concurrent jobs, and precompute manifest so downloads are presigned and expire. Also rate-limit NDJSON size per minute to avoid spike IO.
kevin: Implementation note: store change records in compact proto, convert to NDJSON when user requests export. That lets us keep storage low and convert on demand.
nora: Can we add redaction modes? e.g., actor-pseudonymize, pii-strip, full-redact. Tie that to entitlement/role checks in console.
maria: Yes — add redaction mode param to the export API and show a console banner about what was redacted. Also surface which fields were removed in the manifest.
tim: Dev API sketch: POST /api/v1/audit/exports {tenant, range:{start,end}, redaction:"pseudonymize", sampling:{type:"rate",value:0.01}} returns {job_id, presigned_manifest_url}  // then client polls job_id
aj: Action items: (1) aj/kevin prototype compact proto + NDJSON converter; (2) nora design redaction modes + entitlements; (3) tim/maria wireframe scrubber + playback links; (4) infra: add export job quota + lifecycle docs.
maria: I'll create a GH issue with those items and link the thumbsup reactions here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
